resourceProfile.assessment: English and Hindi sources, runtime corrections, review data, and terminology were available.

automatedQuality.summary: Hindi tests, translation checks, typecheck, full tests, build, routes, and links passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A fresh full-scope Hindi sanity pass found and corrected interpolation and wording defects.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Hindi human review was performed; the corrected entries remain machine-reviewed.

publicationAuthorization.summary: The user requested corrections and a commit, but did not request publication or deployment.

findings.summary: Eleven catalog-manager templates exposed lower-cased machine placeholder tokens.
evidence: The draft used __se_arg_0__ while replacement code matched __SE_ARG_0__.
findings.resolution: Replaced the affected runtime templates with direct typed Hindi interpolation functions.

findings.summary: Four catalog-editor templates exposed lower-cased machine placeholder tokens.
evidence: Edit, new-custom, and save labels retained unresolved __se_arg_0__ text.
findings.resolution: Added direct Hindi interpolation functions and replaced the mistranslated रिवाज wording.

findings.summary: The Ohm adjusting and lock-summary templates exposed lower-cased placeholder tokens.
evidence: The affected templates could render __se_arg_0__ or __se_arg_1__ to visitors.
findings.resolution: Replaced both templates with typed Hindi interpolation functions.

findings.summary: Nicotine strength was mistranslated as good strength.
evidence: The draft label अच्छी ताकत does not identify nicotine concentration.
findings.resolution: Changed the relevant labels to निकोटीन की सांद्रता.

findings.summary: The Percentage label contained residual English marker text.
evidence: The published draft read को PERCENTAGE.

findings.summary: Juice actions and ingredient labels used literal or contextually wrong machine wording.
evidence: Examples included भार for Load and स्वादिष्ट बनाने का मसाला for Flavoring.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the affected action, flavor, amount, and recipe labels in natural Hindi.

findings.summary: Protected ml and g unit symbols were transliterated.
evidence: The draft used एमएल and जी instead of the canonical unit symbols.

findings.summary: The Wraps label remained untranslated English.
Power dissipated used an ungrammatical phrase that obscured the electrical result.
evidence: The draft read नष्ट हुई शक्ति हो गई.
findings.resolution: Changed the result label to शक्ति क्षय.

findings.summary: Wire Wizard labels mixed translated product identity and inconsistent coil terminology.
evidence: The title was तार जादूगर and the import label duplicated वायर.
findings.resolution: Restored Wire Wizard identity and standardized the corrected coil, wire, and strand labels.

findings.summary: Outer diameter and cross-sectional area used incorrect or malformed geometry terms.
evidence: The draft used बहरी घेरा and संकर अनुभागीय क्षेत्र.
findings.resolution: Changed the labels to बाहरी व्यास and अनुप्रस्थ काट का क्षेत्रफल.

findings.summary: Coil setup labels mixed कुंडल, क्वायल, and कॉइल inconsistently.
evidence: The locale glossary prefers the established vaping term कॉइल.
findings.resolution: Standardized the corrected calculator heading, setup labels, and result labels on कॉइल.
